flashcard_questions.a: Functional protection (corrosion, moisture, UV, wear) and aesthetic enhancement (colour, texture, gloss).
flashcard_questions.q: Name the two main purposes of surface finishes.

flashcard_questions.a: Coating iron or steel with zinc to protect it from corrosion. The zinc acts as a sacrificial layer.
Paper: UV varnishing. Timber: tanalising (or varnishing). Metal: powder coating (or galvanising).
flashcard_questions.q: Name one surface finish for paper/board, timber and metal.

flashcard_questions.a: A pressure treatment that forces chemical preservatives into timber to protect against rot, fungal decay and insect attack.
Dry polymer powder is electrostatically sprayed onto metal, then baked in an oven to form a tough, even, coloured finish.
